claims.content: Allow the Operator to enter free-form text comments into the Daily Diary Log upon logging into the system.

goal.raw_text: Allow the Operator to enter free-form text comments into the Daily Diary Log upon logging into the system.

claims.content: The user must be logged into the system with Operator authority.
The Operator Daily Diary Log entry must be associated with a specific Personnel record.
The Operator Daily Diary Log entry must be associated with a specific Workstation.
The Daily Diary Log is generated automatically when a user with Operator authority logs on to the system.

trigger.raw_text: The Daily Diary Log is generated automatically when a user with Operator authority logs on to the system.

claims.content: The Operator may attempt to update log entries, but the system restricts updates to only those entries associated with the Operator's own login, the current day, and the current shift.
The system saves the free-form text comments entered by the Operator into the Daily Diary Log.
The Operator Daily Diary Log entry is successfully associated with the specific Personnel record of the logged-in Operator.
The Operator Daily Diary Log entry is successfully associated with the specific Workstation used by the Operator.
